description: Refine of r06_explore_patchxattn_s32 with ONE hyperparameter change: no dropout (k = 16,000: residual-branch dropout 0 instead of 0.1 in encoder and decoder; adapt_config dropout 0.10 for n < 1,500, 0.05 for n < 4,000 and 0 above). Everything else identical (batch 256, AdamW lr 1e-3, wd 0.05, EMA, time-aware cosine, bf16). Architecture unchanged (S = 32 spectral patches, P = 63 patch query tokens, renderer Linear(d -> 64) overlap-added with stride 32). Encoder-decoder geometry-to-spectrum transformer with spectral patch queries (Perceiver-IO / DETR-style attention decoder instead of an MLP hea
model_repr:
PatchXAttnTransformer(
  (res_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=8, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (glob_embed): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=2, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (enc): ModuleList(
    (0-1): 2 x EncBlock(
      (n1): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (n2): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (att): SelfAttn(
        (qkv): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=768, bias=True)
        (o): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.0, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (enc_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (z_proj): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=512, out_features=256, bias=True)
    (1): GELU(approximate='none')
    (2): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
  )
  (dec): ModuleList(
    (0-3): 4 x DecBlock(
      (n1): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (n2): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (n3): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
      (sa): SelfAttn(
        (qkv): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=768, bias=True)
        (o): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (ca): CrossAttn(
        (q): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
        (kv): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=512, bias=True)
        (o): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (ff): Sequential(
        (0): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=1024, bias=True)
        (1): GELU(approximate='none')
        (2): Linear(in_features=1024, out_features=256, bias=True)
      )
      (drop): Dropout(p=0.0, inplace=False)
    )
  )
  (dec_norm): LayerNorm((256,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (out): Linear(in_features=256, out_features=64, bias=True)
)
